# THE BUSINESS lb

> Digital growth and business transformation company helping Lebanese SMEs, brands and professionals build their digital presence and grow. Founded by Ralph Chbib in 2026.

THE BUSINESS lb offers: websites, Shopify/e-commerce stores, social media management, AI & automation, and business consulting for Lebanese companies. The primary offer is a free Digital Business Assessment — a structured review of a business's digital position plus a written 90-day roadmap.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://thebusinesslb.com/): overview of services and positioning
- [Digital Business Assessment](https://thebusinesslb.com/digital-assessment/): the primary offer, free for the first five businesses
- [Services](https://thebusinesslb.com/services/): hub for all five services
- [Pricing](https://thebusinesslb.com/pricing/): indicative price ranges by package
- [About](https://thebusinesslb.com/about/): company positioning and beliefs
- [Ralph Chbib](https://thebusinesslb.com/about/ralph-chbib/): founder profile
- [Insights](https://thebusinesslb.com/insights/): articles on digital growth for Lebanese businesses
- [Contact](https://thebusinesslb.com/contact/): WhatsApp, email and contact form
